translations.web: It will happen in that day,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day.
translations.bsb: And in that day, declares the Lord GOD, I will make the sun go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the daytime.
